title: Contact — Content

fields.message: Contact — one tab per section. Edits fill that section's {{slots}} on the live page. Shortcode attributes still override, and a blank field falls back to the built-in default.

fields.label: Show this section
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_show_section
fields.instructions: Untick to take this section off the live page. Nothing is deleted — the wording below stays exactly as it is and comes straight back when you tick it again. Takes up to two minutes to show on the site.

fields.label: Headline
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_heading
fields.instructions: Display face, wraps inside 18ch. Under ~50 characters is a hint not a limit — word length drives the break more than character count. Short is the point here: it is a sign-off, not a sentence. PRESS RETURN to force a line break exactly where you want one.

fields.label: Sub copy
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_sub
fields.instructions: Does real work: it tells the visitor this page is a switchboard, so the cards below read as an answer rather than a runaround. Write — as a literal em dash. PRESS RETURN to force a line break exactly where you want one.
fields.default_value: Whatever you need — a story, a partnership, a job, or just to tell us how we did — here's who to ask.

fields.label: Background photo
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_bg_photo
fields.instructions: Optional. Leave this empty and the hero keeps the flat dark color it has today — nothing changes until you choose a photo. The photo fills the whole hero and is cropped to fit, so its exact size does not matter; around 1920px on the long edge is plenty and anything bigger only slows the page. Light photos make white headlines hard to read, which is what the two overlay settings below are for. If you also set a background video below, this photo is what shows while the video loads and for anyone who has animation switched off.

fields.label: Background photo — phones
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_bg_photo_mobile
fields.instructions: Optional. A version of the hero photo for phones, used below 768px wide. Leave empty and the main photo above is used at every size. Worth setting when the main photo is wide: cropped to a narrow screen it often shows nothing recognizable, and a tall or tighter version reads far better.

fields.label: Background photo — color
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_bg_photo_tone
fields.instructions: Color is the default. Switch this photo to black and white when you want it that way on purpose — the photography on this site was only ever gray because the placeholder images were. Affects this photo alone.

fields.label: Background photo — movement
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_bg_photo_px
fields.instructions: How far this photo drifts inside its frame as you scroll, as a percentage of the frame's height. 0 is off. The dropdown this replaces offered 6, 10 and 16 as Subtle, Medium and Strong, so anything already set still reads exactly the same — you can now pick the values in between. 40 is the ceiling: the page itself stops there, so a larger number would do nothing. The photo is laid out taller than its frame and slides within it, so an edge never appears and it is never zoomed.

fields.label: Background photo — movement direction
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_bg_photo_px_dir
fields.instructions: Which way this photo travels as the page scrolls. Neighboring photos set in opposite directions are what reads as depth.

fields.label: Overlay color
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_overlay_color
fields.instructions: A flat color laid over the background photo to keep the headline readable. This does nothing when no photo is set. Choose None to turn the overlay off entirely.

fields.label: Overlay strength
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_overlay_strength
fields.instructions: How much of the overlay color shows through. Only has an effect once an overlay color is chosen above. 45% is the usual setting for white type over a photo — go higher if the headline still fights the picture, lower if the photo is already dark.

fields.label: Background video (optional)
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_video_id
fields.instructions: Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link, or just the ID. Leave blank to use the photo above, or the flat hero color if there is no photo. The video plays silently on a loop with no controls. The photo shows while the video loads, if the video is blocked, and for visitors who have switched off animation — so it is worth setting one as well.

fields.label: Video from
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_video_source
fields.instructions: Which service the link is from. Only matters when a video is set.

fields.label: Section background
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_section_bg
fields.instructions: A pattern or photo filling this whole section, behind everything else. Leave it empty — as it is now — and the section keeps the plain color it has today; nothing changes until you choose something. It is cropped to fill, so the exact size does not matter. ON A DARK SECTION USE A LIGHT OR GRAY ARTWORK: a black pattern over a black panel stays invisible however high you set the strength below. ON A HERO THIS SITS BEHIND THE HERO PHOTO, so it only shows where that photo does not: with a background photo set, the photo covers the section edge to edge and this is hidden entirely. Use it on a hero with no photo, where it replaces the flat color.

fields.label: Background strength
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_section_bg_opacity
fields.instructions: How strongly the background shows through. Choose 100% when the artwork already has the intended strength built into the file — anything lower then fades a graphic that was supplied ready to use. Use the lower values when a full-strength image would compete with the words in front of it.

fields.label: Background movement
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_section_bg_px
fields.instructions: Drifts the background as the page scrolls, behind the content, as a percentage of the section's height. 0 is off — the right starting point, because a pattern moving too fast pulls the eye away from the copy. 6 is subtle, 10 medium, 16 strong, and anything in between is allowed. 40 is the ceiling; the page stops there.

fields.label: Background movement direction
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_section_bg_px_dir
fields.instructions: Which way the background travels as the page scrolls. Only matters once movement above is above 0. Neighboring sections set in opposite directions are what reads as depth rather than as one sheet sliding.

fields.label: Section background — phones
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_section_bg_mobile
fields.instructions: Optional. A version of the background for phones, used below 768px wide. Leave it empty and the main background above is used at every size. Worth setting when the main artwork is wide: cropped to a narrow screen it often shows nothing recognizable, and a tall or simplified version reads far better.

fields.label: Artwork
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_mark_1_brg_art
fields.instructions: Which mark is drawn here. Leave it alone to keep the one the design uses. Any SVG or PNG from the media library works; SVG stays crisp at any size.

fields.label: Position
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_mark_1_brg_pos
fields.instructions: Where the mark sits in its section. "Where the design put it" is the starting point and leaves it exactly where it is now — choose one of the nine only when you want to move it. Corners sit inside the section padding, so a long headline cannot push a mark down into the type.

fields.label: Opacity
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_mark_1_brg_opacity
fields.instructions: How solid the mark is. 100 is as drawn; lower settles it into the background.

fields.label: Show this mark
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_mark_1_brg_show
fields.instructions: Hiding removes just this one mark. Nothing else in the section changes.

fields.label: Animation
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_mark_1_brg_anim
fields.instructions: How the mark moves. "As built" keeps what it does today — a hard-cut jitter for most, a spin for the asterisk in the hero cluster. Still stops it entirely. Anyone who has switched off animation in their system settings sees it still whatever is chosen here.

fields.label: Artwork
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_mark_2_smile_art
fields.instructions: Which mark is drawn here. Leave it alone to keep the one the design uses. Any SVG or PNG from the media library works; SVG stays crisp at any size.

fields.label: Position
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_mark_2_smile_pos
fields.instructions: Where the mark sits in its section. "Where the design put it" is the starting point and leaves it exactly where it is now — choose one of the nine only when you want to move it. Corners sit inside the section padding, so a long headline cannot push a mark down into the type.

fields.label: Opacity
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_mark_2_smile_opacity
fields.instructions: How solid the mark is. 100 is as drawn; lower settles it into the background.

fields.label: Show this mark
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_mark_2_smile_show
fields.instructions: Hiding removes just this one mark. Nothing else in the section changes.

fields.label: Animation
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_mark_2_smile_anim
fields.instructions: How the mark moves. "As built" keeps what it does today — a hard-cut jitter for most, a spin for the asterisk in the hero cluster. Still stops it entirely. Anyone who has switched off animation in their system settings sees it still whatever is chosen here.

fields.label: Where the buttons sit
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_cta_position
fields.instructions: At the bottom is the usual place and the one the rest of the site uses.

choices.foot: At the bottom of the section
choices.head: Directly under the heading

fields.label: Buttons
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_buttons
fields.instructions:
Buttons for this section. Add as many as you need — they sit in a row and wrap onto the next line on a narrow screen. Leave the list empty, as it is now, and the section has no buttons at all and looks exactly as it does today.

Their color, fill and hover come from Button style below and apply to all of them.

sub_fields.label: Label
sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.instructions: The words on the button. Short reads best: it is set in capitals with wide letter spacing. A button with no label is not drawn.

sub_fields.label: Link
sub_fields.name: href
sub_fields.instructions: Where it goes. A path like /careers/ stays on this site, a full address goes off it, and mailto:someone@blacktoprg.com opens a mail window.

sub_fields.label: Open in a pop-up
sub_fields.name: popup
sub_fields.instructions: For a Google Form, choose Pop-up and it opens in a panel over the page instead of sending people to Google. A form that is set to require a Google sign-in CANNOT be shown this way — Google's sign-in page refuses to be embedded and the panel comes up blank — so that one has to stay on Open the link until its Responses settings are changed. Anything that is not a form stays on Open the link.

fields.label: Pop-up background
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_modal_bg
fields.instructions: The color of the panel a form opens in. Match it to the form's own Theme color in Google Forms and the two read as one surface. This cannot color the form itself — that is Google's page on Google's domain.

fields.label: Button color
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_btn_color
fields.instructions: The button's color. "As designed" is the starting point and leaves this section's buttons exactly as they look today — which matters, because several sections paint theirs black on purpose and the give-back slider alternates yellow and black down the slides. Choose a color and it takes over. The words flip to black or white automatically, whichever reads on the color you pick. This applies to every button in this section.

fields.label: Filled or outline
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_btn_style
fields.instructions: Filled is a solid block of color. Outline draws the color as a ring with the words in it and nothing behind — useful over a photo, where a solid block can sit heavily. "As designed" leaves it as it is today, which is filled everywhere. Both are exactly the same size, so switching one does not move anything around it.

fields.label: Hover effect
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_btn_effect
fields.instructions:
What the button does when someone points at it. Lift is what every button has always done and stays the default — it rises slightly and casts a shadow. Lift and swap color does that AND flips to the opposite ink, which is the loudest of the set and best kept for one main action on a page. Underline draws a rule under the words and leaves the button still, which reads as a link — a good fit for the small buttons. Grow swells it in place. Press down pushes it into the page. Fill in floods an outline button with its color, so pair it with Outline. None holds it still.

This is the HOVER only; the way the button arrives on screen is the site-wide reveal. Anyone who has switched off animation sees no hover movement whatever is chosen.

fields.label: Background style
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_bg_style
fields.instructions: What fills the hero behind the words. "Photo or video" is how every hero works today. "Splash animation" plays the entrance from the coming-soon page — the photos slide and fade in once, then drift slowly. The splash's graphics are not included.

fields.label: Splash — full-screen photo
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_splash_skater
fields.instructions: The one that covers the whole hero and fades in while scaling down. Leave empty for the skater from the splash page.

fields.label: Full-screen photo
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_splash_skater_on
fields.instructions: Hiding this leaves the three smaller plates on the dark base.

fields.label: Splash — bottom left
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_splash_car
fields.instructions: Slides in from the left. Leave empty for the car from the splash page.

fields.label: Splash — bottom right
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_splash_surfer
fields.instructions: Slides in from the bottom right. Leave empty for the surfer from the splash page.

fields.label: Splash — top right
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_splash_crown
fields.instructions: Fades in and sits small in the top corner. Leave empty for the spray crown from the splash page.

fields.label: Top right
fields.name: brg_contact_hero_splash_crown_on
fields.instructions: This is the one plate that reads as a graphic rather than a photograph, so it has its own switch.

Underline draws a rule under the words and leaves the button still, which reads as a link — a good fit for the small buttons. Grow swells it in place. Press down pushes it into the page. Fill in floods an outline button with its color, so pair it with Outline. None holds it still.

This is the HOVER only; the way the button arrives on screen is the site-wide reveal. Anyone who has switched off animation sees no hover movement whatever is chosen.

fields.label: Buttons
fields.name: brg_contact_restaurants_buttons
fields.instructions:
Buttons for this section. Add as many as you need — they sit in a row and wrap onto the next line on a narrow screen. Leave the list empty, as it is now, and the section has no buttons at all and looks exactly as it does today.

Their color, fill and hover come from Button style below and apply to all of them.

sub_fields.label: Label
sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.instructions: The words on the button. Short reads best: it is set in capitals with wide letter spacing. A button with no label is not drawn.

sub_fields.label: Link
sub_fields.name: href
sub_fields.instructions: Where it goes. A path like /careers/ stays on this site, a full address goes off it, and mailto:someone@blacktoprg.com opens a mail window.

sub_fields.label: Open in a pop-up
sub_fields.name: popup
sub_fields.instructions: For a Google Form, choose Pop-up and it opens in a panel over the page instead of sending people to Google. A form that is set to require a Google sign-in CANNOT be shown this way — Google's sign-in page refuses to be embedded and the panel comes up blank — so that one has to stay on Open the link until its Responses settings are changed. Anything that is not a form stays on Open the link.

fields.label: Where the buttons sit
fields.name: brg_contact_restaurants_cta_position
fields.instructions: At the bottom is the usual place and the one the rest of the site uses. This section has no heading, so the bottom is the only position offered.

choices.foot: At the bottom of the section

fields.label: Pop-up background
fields.name: brg_contact_restaurants_modal_bg
fields.instructions: The color of the panel a form opens in. Match it to the form's own Theme color in Google Forms and the two read as one surface. This cannot color the form itself — that is Google's page on Google's domain.

description: Editable content for the Contact page, one tab per section. Generated — edit website/sections/<id>/slots.json and rerun kit/build-acf.py.
